name: zoom
description: Reads Zoom users, meetings, webinars, bounded module-specific data, SCIM2 groups/users, and Virtual Agent knowledge-base/report data through the Zoom REST API; includes sensitive Cobrowse SDK, SCIM2, and Virtual Agent reads, approval-gated Chatbot, SCIM2, Virtual Agent, clinical-note, and Quality Management actions, and a redacted Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival key action.

risk.read: external Zoom API read of user, meeting, webinar, Quality of Service, AI Companion, My Notes, healthcare clinical-note, Quality Management, Cobrowse SDK session, SCIM2 user/group, and Virtual Agent knowledge-base/report data
risk.write: typed Zoom Chatbot message, Link Unfurls, SCIM2 group/user, Virtual Agent article/sync, healthcare clinical-note, and Quality Management actions, plus Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival key decryption with redacted output
risk.approval: mutating commands require plan, preview, explicit approval, and execute; Chatbot, SCIM2, and Virtual Agent article deletion plus Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival key decryption additionally require typed confirmation; read-only commands require none
